Build has of course the highest upfront cost and the longest timeline, but you get exactly what you want and full control of it. The downside is that you own all the maintenance and the updates and often times that's actually more expensive going forward than the initial development.

[02:09] Buy is the fastest way to value. You're live in a few weeks, but you're constrained by what that vendor gives you and you'll need workarounds for your edge cases. Extend is your middle ground. You get to the market reasonably fast and you have vendor support, but you add customization on top.
